## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated. For a bug fix, a test that fails without the fix.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check` passes.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes for the crates touched.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased, in plain language, with an area label and no tracker ids.
- [ ] Screenshots attached if the visuals change.
- [ ] No version bumps.
